One consulting call, three lengths
Felix Moreau offers his consulting call as 15, 30 or 60 minutes. Follow it from his event setup to the hour Martin Kerr books.
Event setup
Allow multiple durations
Felix turns on Allow multiple durations for his consulting call and adds 15, 30 and 60 minutes as the available durations.
Event setup
Pick the length the page opens on
He sets 30 minutes as the default duration. His event types list now shows a badge for each of the three lengths.
Booking page
Martin sees the lengths as choices
Martin opens the link in London. The lengths sit under the call's title with 30m already picked, and Thursday shows half-hour times around Felix's meetings.
Booking page
A longer call, fewer times
He picks 1h. Each time now needs a free hour behind it, so Thursday drops from 11 times to 4. He takes 12:00pm.
Booking confirmed
The full hour lands on Felix's calendar
The confirmation shows 12:00pm to 1:00pm, and Felix gets the booking for the hour Martin picked, not his 30-minute default.

Questions about multiple durations
Which lengths you can offer, and how bookers see them.
Ask a question
What does Allow multiple durations do?
It lets one event type come in several lengths. You choose the lengths and a default, and the booker picks one on your booking page before choosing a time.
Which lengths can I offer?
Any of the preset lengths from 5 minutes up to 8 hours, as many as you like. 15, 30 and 60 minutes is a common set.
Why does a longer length show fewer times?
A time shows only if the whole call fits in your free time. Times also step by the picked length unless you set your own time-slot interval, so an hour-long call starts on the hour.
Can I link someone straight to one length?
Yes. Add a duration to the link, like ?duration=60, and the booking page opens on that length if it's one you offer. Any other value opens on the default.
Can I hide the choice from bookers?
Yes. Tick Hide duration selector and the booking page shows one length instead of the choices.
Does it work with seats?
No. With seats on, the Allow multiple durations switch is disabled, and the app tells you the seat option doesn't support multiple durations.
